newsitem.title: UK: Labour to postpones manifesto by one day.
newsitem.headline: Labour to postpones manifesto by one day.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party said on Tuesday that it would postpone publishing its manifesto so it will not clash with the release of the Conservatives' proposals.
Labour, which is leading the Conservatives by 25 points in the latest opinion polls, will unveil their document on Thursday, April 3, one day later than planned.
Labour campaign manager Peter Mandelson said the Conservatives wanted to use Labour's launch as a smokescreen for their manifesto.
